CustomField.description: BRME-5498: Formula field that combines Role, From, and To values into a single display text (e.g., “Role (Start - End)”). Created to reduce field clutter in related lists and optimize available space for additional columns.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(TEXT(Role__c)), "", IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(From__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(To__c, "")), TEXT(Role__c), IF( ISPICKVAL(From__c, ""), TEXT(Role__c) & " (End: " & TEXT(To__c) & ")", IF( ISPICKVAL(To__c, ""), TEXT(Role__c) & " (Start: " & TEXT(From__c) & ")", TEXT(Role__c) & " (" & TEXT(From__c) & " - " & TEXT(To__c) & ")" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Role
